name: agentdust
description: Explain AgentDust reports and local setup.

interface.longDescription: Explain AgentDust process and disk reports that users provide, and guide local setup. This skills package does not connect to a Mac or provide live process access. Live inspection requires a separately configured local AgentDust MCP connection. Manual cleanup requires AgentDust's typed approval. Automatic cleanup requires a user-authorized local directory policy.
defaultPrompt: Help me understand this AgentDust disk report:
How do I set up AgentDust locally?

publication.release_notes: Adds batch directory enablement and user-authorized unattended CLI setup guidance for AgentDust 1.2.0. The package contains skills only; live inspection requires a separate local MCP connection.
